player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Player {player_id} m'mwendo wa Indian Poker.
- Deki la khadi 52; mumuona khadi ya mnzako.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila mwendo, {max_rounds} mwendo (s) wathunthu.
- Zomwe zingatheka: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ndi nambari chanya <= ndalama zanu za chip.)
- Khadi iliyo juu ambayo haionekani imenyeza pot pa showdown.
